title: Council of Impossible Furniture
subtitle: A 3D standards committee where every chair fails upward.
learning: One Component contract can admit different realizations. Geometry, projection and presentation remain separate authorities.

nodes.label: Component
nodes.detail: The Component requires a finite, interactive chair-like projection.

nodes.label: Geometry
nodes.detail: Vertices and edges own the object without owning the camera.

nodes.label: Projection
nodes.detail: A perspective transform maps 3D points into the 2D artifact.

nodes.label: Canvas
nodes.detail: Canvas owns line style and motion.

nodes.label: Acceptance
nodes.detail: Finite geometry and visible boundaries are independently inspectable.
